segments.name: Dental
segments.description: Sells computer-controlled local anesthesia delivery instruments and single-use disposable handpieces to dental practitioners worldwide.
segments.evidence: In the dental market, the Company's products are marketed under the CompuDent® and STA Single Tooth Anesthesia System® trademarks and utilize The Wand®, a single-use disposable handpiece.

segments.name: Medical
products: CompuFlo® Epidural Computer Controlled Anesthesia System
segments.description: Provides computer-controlled drug delivery systems with Dynamic Pressure Sensing technology for epidural anesthesia and other medical injection procedures.
segments.evidence: The Company has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") 510(k) clearance for its CompuFlo® Epidural Computer Controlled Anesthesia System for use in specified regions of the spine.

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue primarily from selling dental and medical instruments and related single-use disposable handpieces to distributors and directly to dental offices via an e-commerce portal.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue is derived primarily from the sale of dental and medical instruments and related single-use disposable handpieces.
